symptom.yue: 張紙上面寫，如果坐住唔郁或者瞓平嗰陣都覺得氣促。
symptom.cmn: 这张纸上写着，如果不动的时候或者躺平的时候也觉得气促。
symptom.en: The sheet says: if she is short of breath while resting or lying flat.

action.yue: 就即刻去急症室，或者打 999，唔好等。
action.cmn: 就马上去急诊室，或者打 999，不要等。
action.en: go straight to A&E or call 999 — don't wait.

source.quote: 1. Shortness of breath at rest or when lying flat.

action.yue: 就即刻去急症室，或者打 999，唔好等。
action.cmn: 就马上去急诊室，或者打 999，不要等。
action.en: go straight to A&E or call 999 — don't wait.

symptom.yue: 如果胸口痛，唞完都唔散。
symptom.cmn: 如果胸口痛，休息了也不缓解。
symptom.en: If she has chest pain that doesn't go away after resting.

action.yue: 就即刻去急症室，或者打 999，唔好等。
action.cmn: 就马上去急诊室，或者打 999，不要等。
action.en: go straight to A&E or call 999 — don't wait.

source.quote: 3. Chest pain that does not go away after resting.

spoken.yue: Amoxicillin-Clavulanate 1g，一粒，一日兩次，食完飯先食，食 5 日。
spoken.cmn: Amoxicillin-Clavulanate 1g，一片，一天两次，饭后服用，吃 5 天。
spoken.en: Amoxicillin-Clavulanate 1g, 1 tab, twice a day after food, for 5 days.

source.quote: 1 Amoxicillin-Clavulanate 1g 1 tab BD after food 5 days

spoken.yue: Paracetamol 500mg，發燒嗰陣先食，一次兩粒，一日四次，食 5 日。
spoken.cmn: Paracetamol 500mg，发烧的时候才吃，一次两片，一天四次，吃 5 天。
spoken.en: Paracetamol 500mg, 2 tabs, four times a day only when she has a fever, for 5 days.

source.quote: 2 Paracetamol 500mg 2 tabs QID PRN for fever 5 days

spoken.yue: Amlodipine 5mg，一粒，每日一次，食 28 日。
spoken.cmn: Amlodipine 5mg，一片，每天一次，吃 28 天。
spoken.en: Amlodipine 5mg, 1 tab, once a day, for 28 days.

spoken.yue: Simvastatin 20mg，一粒，每晚一次，食 28 日。Nocte 喺張紙上面即係夜晚食。
spoken.cmn: Simvastatin 20mg，一片，每晚一次，吃 28 天。纸上的 Nocte 就是晚上吃。
spoken.en: Simvastatin 20mg, 1 tab, once at night, for 28 days. Nocte on the sheet means at night.

spoken.yue: Diclofenac 50mg：張紙將呢隻擺咗喺「今次住院已停用藥物」嗰欄，寫住出院之後唔使再食。
spoken.cmn: Diclofenac 50mg：这张纸把它列在「这次住院已停用药物」那一栏，写着出院后不用再吃。
spoken.en: Diclofenac 50mg: the sheet lists this one under medicines stopped this admission, and says it is not to be taken after going home.

source.section: MEDICATIONS STOPPED THIS ADMISSION — NOT TO BE TAKEN AFTER DISCHARGE

spoken.yue: 張紙寫住，10 月 7 號星期三早上 10 點 15 分，返 MED SOPD 內科專科門診覆診，記得帶埋呢張紙同所有藥袋。
spoken.cmn: 这张纸上写着，10 月 7 日星期三上午 10 点 15 分，回 MED SOPD 内科专科门诊复诊，记得带上这张纸和所有药袋。
spoken.en: The sheet says: come back to MED SOPD on 07-10-2026, a Wednesday, at 10:15 in the morning, and bring this sheet and all the drug bags.

source.quote: 1. Clinic: MED SOPD, 07-10-2026 (Wed) 10:15. Bring this sheet and all drug bags.

spoken.yue: 9 月 30 號星期三早上 8 點到 9 點，去地下嘅抽血室空肚抽血。
spoken.cmn: 9 月 30 日星期三上午 8 点到 9 点，去地下的抽血室空腹抽血。
spoken.en: On 30-09-2026, a Wednesday, between 8 and 9 in the morning, go to the Specimen Collection Room on G/F for a fasting blood test.

source.quote: 2. Blood test: fasting bloods, Specimen Collection Room G/F, 30-09-2026 (Wed) 08:00 - 09:00.

dietLine.raw: Diet: low salt diet. No added salt or soy sauce at the table.

spoken.yue: 張紙飲食嗰行寫住：低鹽飲食，食飯嗰陣唔好再加鹽同豉油。
spoken.cmn: 这张纸饮食那一行写着：低盐饮食，吃饭的时候不要再加盐和酱油。
spoken.en: The food line on the sheet says: a low salt diet, with no extra salt or soy sauce added at the table.

source.quote: 1. Diet: low salt diet. No added salt or soy sauce at the table.

activityLine.text: Activity: light activity at home. No heavy lifting and no strenuous exercise for 2 weeks.

spoken.yue: 張紙寫住：喺屋企做啲輕鬆活動就得，兩個星期內唔好搬重嘢，亦唔好做劇烈運動。
spoken.cmn: 这张纸上写着：在家做些轻松的活动就好，两周内不要提重物，也不要做剧烈运动。
spoken.en: The sheet says: light activity at home, and for two weeks no heavy lifting and no hard exercise.

source.quote: 2. Activity: light activity at home. No heavy lifting and no strenuous exercise for 2 weeks.
